name: 泥潭三 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan_san)
english_description: The true 'third generation' release of the NT/nitan/Lonely engine lineage — its login banner literally reads 'once you enter the Mire, it runs as deep as the sea.' Like its close relative nitan_ceshi, it's branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm,' a skin over the shared nitan engine. A direct file-level comparison shows the two are near-total duplicates of the same authored world rather than independently evolved games: about 98% of matching-path files under d/ — the same Central-Plains cities, the same Five Great Sects, the same frontier zones — are byte-identical, while the two diverge much more in their engine layers (kungfu skills, commands, admin daemons each differ in roughly a third of files), pointing to separate later snapshots of one shared codebase. Character creation follows the same creation-myth path: choose a name and personality, reroll stats, and be delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life. It shares its sibling's independence from any external database — registration and saves are entirely local-file-based. A separate git-hosted mirror of this exact codebase is also in this collection as nitan3, confirmed byte-identical across 15,235 of 15,236 shared files and marked as a duplicate of this entry.
